newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Goldman starts Norwich Union.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Goldman starts Norwich Union.

text.p: Norwich Union Plc, the former mutually-owned insurance group that floated on the UK equity market on Monday, was rated "market underperformer" at Goldman Sachs as the investment bank started coverage of the stock, Goldman said on Tuesday.
Goldman said it had an "appraisal value" of 282p on the stock and a target price of 300p, allowing for industry restructuring potential. Further detail was not immediately available.
The stock was down 3-1/2p at 321 by 1120 GMT, continuing a retreat from Monday's opening gain but still above the public offer price of 290p.
